protocol.scope: Stationarity, unconstrained linear diagnostic only, directional full Hessian. No outer step.
protocol.pilot_gate: chi>=.01 and eta384<=.1 and validated kappa>=.5; OR eta>=.5 with full normal ratio<.001 and last2 eta gains<.001.

stationarity.warning: Estimated norm, not rigorous upper bound. Small chi does not prove a nonzero minimum or absence of roots.
